blind.description: An ancient Egyptian canopic jar with a jackal (Anubis) head lid. It features an urn-shaped vessel body tapering toward a flat base, a painted red and gold decorative band with geometric patterns around the upper body, and a sculpted jackal head with tall erect ears, black facial markings, and red inner ears. The surfaces are smooth, solid, and fully continuous with no missing geometry or floating parts.
blind.from_above: A circular vessel silhouette topped with an animal head, showing the snout protruding forward and two pointed ears angled backward, casting a distinct two-eared shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/5 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 13 to 15 inches tall) and about 6 inches in diameter.

match.reads_as: canopic jar with carved animal head stopper
